Load packages & misc

```{r load-packages}
# Package list
packages <- c("nlme",
              "MuMIn", # for r.squared in lme models
              "ggplot2",
              "ggpubr", # for the pubclean theme
              "ggridges",
              "gridExtra",
              "cowplot", # for arranging plots
              "infotheo",
              "lme4",
              "car", # for vif measure
              "RColorBrewer", # for color palettes
              "latex2exp", # for latex notation in the plots
              "reshape2",
              "formattable", # for nice tables
              "htmltools", # for outputting the table
              "webshot", # for outputting the table
              "ggdist") # for half violin plots

# Install packages not yet installed
installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}

# Packages loading
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

# Time plots

Time plots of the evolution of noise and mean under directional selection

## Read params
read params from the establishment of mutation-selection balance & scenEvol

```{r read-params}
# read params (mutation-selection balance)
prmsS_forMutSelBalance <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsS_forMutSelBalance"), 
                                     sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
NUM_NODES = prmsS_forMutSelBalance[rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "NUM_NODES", ]
NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance = prmsS_forMutSelBalance[rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "NUM_GENERATIONS", ]
prmsV_forMutSelBalance <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsV_forMutSelBalance"),
                                               sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1))
ylim_noise_lower <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_NOISE_LOWERBOUND"), ]
ylim_noise_upper <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_NOISE_UPPERBOUND"), ]
ylim_sbasal_lower <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_SBASAL_LOWERBOUND"), ]
ylim_sbasal_upper <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_SBASAL_UPPERBOUND"), ]

# calculate indices of genotypes, phenotypes, and fitness
numIDCols = 2
indIDCols = c(1, 2)
indGenotNoiseCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + 1, to = numIDCols  + NUM_NODES, by = 1)
indGenotSBasalCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + NUM_NODES + 1, to = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES, by = 1)
indGenotNetCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES + 1, to = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES + NUM_NODES^2, by = 1)
indPhenotypeCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES + NUM_NODES^2 + 1, to = numIDCols  + 3*NUM_NODES + NUM_NODES^2, by = 1)
indFitnessCol = numIDCols + length(indGenotNoiseCols) + length(indGenotSBasalCols) + 
                length(indGenotNetCols) + length(indPhenotypeCols) + 1
pop0FirstgenRealized <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "pop.MSB.firstgen"),
                                   sep = " ", header = FALSE)
sSteady = pop0FirstgenRealized[1, indPhenotypeCols]

# names
node_names = paste("G", 1:NUM_NODES, sep = "")
meanGenotColnames <- paste("meanG_", node_names, sep = "")
meanPhenotColnames <- paste("meanP_", node_names, sep = "")
varPhenotColnames <- paste("varP_", node_names, sep = "")

# read params (dirSel)
#prmsS_sel <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath, "prmsS_sel_oppDir_rep1"),
prmsS_sel <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsS_dirSelPos_rep1"),
                        sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
NUM_GENERATIONS = prmsS_sel[rownames(prmsS_sel) == "NUM_GENERATIONS", ]
S_MAX = prmsS_sel[rownames(prmsS_sel) == "S_MAX", ]
prmsV_39stab1dir <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsV_39stab_1dirSelPos"),
                                         sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1))
#prmsV_39stab1dir <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(resultsPath, "prmsV_39stab_1dirNeg"),
#                                         sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1))

# read params (fluctSel)
#prmsS_fluctSel <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath, "prmsS_fluctSel_rep1"),
#                        sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
#NUM_GENERATIONS = prmsS_sel[rownames(prmsS_sel) == "NUM_GENERATIONS", ]

# which genes had a change of selection regime?
indexSelGene <- as.integer(which(prmsV_39stab1dir["S_OPT_DELTA", ] != 0))
```

## Dir sel

```{r read-dir-sel}
resultsFolderForTimePlots = "20230411_ER_40node/net_14/"
resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath = paste0("../results/", resultsFolderForTimePlots)

# get sOpt value for the gene under dir.
sOpt <- prmsV_39stab1dir[rownames(prmsV_39stab1dir) == "S_OPT", indexSelGene] +
  prmsV_39stab1dir[rownames(prmsV_39stab1dir) == "S_OPT_DELTA", indexSelGene]

dirHist <- MSBHist
dirHist$rep <- 0
dirNoises <- MSBNoises
dirNoises$rep <- 0
dirSbasals <- MSBSbasals
dirSbasals$rep <-0 

for(repNum in 1:numReps)
{
  # read hist file
  #hist <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath, "dirSelOpp_rep", repNum, ".hist"), header = FALSE)
  hist <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutNoise_rep", repNum, ".hist"), header = FALSE)
  colnames(hist) <- c("generation", meanPhenotColnames, varPhenotColnames, "meanF")
  hist$rep <- repNum
  hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance
  
  # read noises file
  #noises <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath,"dirSelOpp_rep", repNum, ".noises"), header = FALSE)
  noises <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath,"dirSelPos_mutNoise_rep", repNum, ".noises"), header = FALSE)
  colnames(noises) <- c("generation", meanGenotColnames)
  noises$rep <- repNum
  noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance
  
  # read sbasals file
  #sbasals <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath,"dirSelOpp_rep", repNum, ".sbasals"), header = FALSE)
  #sbasals <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath,"dirSelPos_mutSNoise_rep", repNum, ".sbasals"), header = FALSE)
  #colnames(sbasals) <- c("generation", meanGenotColnames)
  #sbasals$rep <- repNum
  #sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance
  
  dirHist <- rbind(dirHist, hist)
  dirNoises <- rbind(dirNoises, noises)
  #dirSbasals <- rbind(dirSbasals, sbasals)
}
```

```{r read-summarized-results}
allReplEvolResults <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "allReplEvolResults_dirSelPos.txt"),
#allReplEvolResults <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath, "allReplEvolResults_dirSelNeg.txt"),
                                 sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
#allReplEvolResultsSel <- allReplEvolResults[allReplEvolResults$scen == "sel", ]
timeToAdapt <- as.numeric(as.character(allReplEvolResults$timeToAdapt[allReplEvolResults$gene == node_names[indexSelGene]]))
generationAdaptationOccurs <- timeToAdapt + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance
```

```{r plot-dir-sel}
# peek
plot_pop_fitness_dirSel <- 
  ggplot(data = dirHist[!is.nan(dirHist$meanP_G1), ],
         aes(x = generation, y = meanF, group = rep)) +
  geom_line(color = fitnessColor, alpha = 0.8) +
  ylab("Mean fitness") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance, color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = generationAdaptationOccurs, color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  ylim(-0.1, 1)
plot_pop_fitness_dirSel
#ggsave(filename = "mutSelBalance-dirScenEvol-continuation-fitness.png",
#       plot = plot_pop_fitness_dirSel,
#       path = plotsFolderWithPath_dirSelPos,
#       device = "png", scale = 2, width = 6, height = 5, units = "cm",
#       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE,
#       bg = "white")

plot_phenotypes_dirSel <- ggplot(data = dirHist[ , c(1, indexSelGene + 1, dim(dirHist)[2])],
                                  aes(x = generation, y = get(paste0("meanP_", node_names[indexSelGene])))) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.25, fill = "gray") +
  geom_point(aes(group = rep), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, color = phenotypeColor) +
  geom_line(aes(group = rep), size = 0.25, alpha = 0.5, color = phenotypeColor) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = 'line', size = 1.5, color = phenotypeColor) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sOpt, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 1500, y = sOpt + 3, label = 'New optimum') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance, color = "black", alpha = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = generationAdaptationOccurs, color = "black", alpha = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  #annotate('text', x = NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance/2, y = 15, label = "MS balance") + 
  #annotate('text', x = (NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance + generationAdaptationOccurs)/2,
  #         y = 15, label = "Adaptation") + 
  #annotate('text', x = (generationAdaptationOccurs + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS)/2,
  #         y = 15, label = "Postadaptation") + 
  geom_label(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance/2, y = 15, label = "MS balance") +
  geom_label(x = (NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance + generationAdaptationOccurs)/2,
             y = 15, label = "Adaptation") +
  geom_label(x = (generationAdaptationOccurs + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS)/2,
             y = 15, label = "Postadaptation") +
  labs(y = "Mean expression level") + 
  ylim(0, 100)
#plot_phenotypes_dirSel
#ggsave(filename = "plot_phenotypes_dirSel.png",
#       plot = plot_phenotypes_dirSel,
#       path = plotsFolderWithPath_dirSelPos,
#       device = "png", scale = 2.5, width = 6, height = 5, units = "cm",
#       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE,
#       bg = "white")

plot_selGene_vars_dirSel <- ggplot(data = dirHist[ , c(1, (indexSelGene + 1 + NUM_NODES), dim(dirHist)[2])],

  geom_point(aes(group = rep), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, color = noiseColor) +

  stat_summary(data = dirHist[dirHist$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance,
                              c(1, (indexSelGene + 1 + NUM_NODES), dim(dirHist)[2])],
```

# Net evol: Directional selection +
Read the genotype, phenotype and fitness information of evolved populations of 2000 random network topology samples.


```{r read-data-dir-sel-withnoise}
allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allNetsResults_prepped_dirSelPos_mutNoise.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
#allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allNetsResults_prepped_dirSelPos.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
allNetsResults$adapted <- (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "Not_applied") &
                          (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "NC_adaptation") &
                          (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "Nonadaptive")
allNetsResults$underDirSel <- allNetsResults$sOptDelta != 0
allNetsResults$regCategory <- factor(allNetsResults$regCategory, levels = c("masterTF", "interTF", "TG"))

# there are 3 isolated (nonconnected) genes in network 4, it's a mistake from RGenNet. The network has 6 componenets (subnetworks).
# I remove it because this network has subnetworks.
allNetsResults <- allNetsResults[-which(allNetsResults$net == 4), ]

# subset networks in which the gene adapted
numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults$net[allNetsResults$adapted == TRUE]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$net %in% numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes, ]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$timeToAdapt_dirSel <- as.numeric(as.character(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$timeToAdapt_dirSel))

#
netsWithInf <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net[is.infinite(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$aveNormChangeVar_PA)]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[!allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net %in% netsWithInf, ]

# all genes under dir and stab sel
genesUnderDirSel <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$sOptDelta != 0, ]
genesUnderStabSel <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$sOptDelta == 0, ]

dirSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == TRUE, ]
stabSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == FALSE, ]

allNetsResults$mutableNoise <- TRUE

allNetsResults <-
  allNetsResults[, -which(colnames(allNetsResults) %in% c("meanGenotEta_1", "meanGenotEta_10000", 
                                                                             "selpress_eta_A", "selpress_eta_A_abs",
                                                                             "selpress_eta_PA", "selpress_eta_PA_abs"))]

networksAdaptedWithNoise <- unique(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net)
```

```{r read-data-dir-sel-withoutnoise}
#allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allNetsResults_dirSelPos.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
#allNetsResults$mutableNoise <- FALSE
allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allNetsResults_prepped_dirSelPos_mutNoise.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
allNetsResults$adapted <- (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "Not_applied") &
                          (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "NC_adaptation") &
                          (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "Nonadaptive")
allNetsResults$underDirSel <- allNetsResults$sOptDelta != 0
allNetsResults$regCategory <- factor(allNetsResults$regCategory, levels = c("masterTF", "interTF", "TG"))

# there are three isolated (nonconnected) genes, it's a mistake from RGenNet
allNetsResults <- allNetsResults[!is.na(allNetsResults$regCategory), ]

# subset networks in which the gene adapted
numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults$net[allNetsResults$adapted == TRUE]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$net %in% numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes, ]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$timeToAdapt_dirSel <- as.numeric(as.character(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$timeToAdapt_dirSel))

#
netsWithInf <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net[is.infinite(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$aveNormChangeVar_PA)]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[!allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net %in% netsWithInf, ]

# all genes under dir and stab sel
genesUnderDirSel <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$sOptDelta != 0, ]
genesUnderStabSel <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$sOptDelta == 0, ]

dirSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == TRUE, ]
stabSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == FALSE, ]

networksAdaptedWithoutNoise <- unique(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net)
```

```{r combine-with-and-without-noise}
overlappedNets <- intersect(unique(allNetsResults_withNoise$net), unique(allNetsResults$net))
allNetsResults_joint <- rbind(allNetsResults_withNoise, allNetsResults)
allNetsResults_joint <- allNetsResults_joint[allNetsResults_joint$net %in% overlappedNets, ]

netsWithInf <- allNetsResults_joint$net[is.infinite(allNetsResults_joint$aveNormChangeVar_PA)]
allNetsResults_joint <- allNetsResults_joint[!allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net %in% netsWithInf, ]

allNetsResults_joint$timeToAdapt_dirSel <-  as.numeric(as.character(allNetsResults_joint$timeToAdapt_dirSel))

# no noise
allNetsResults_wo_noise <- allNetsResults_joint[allNetsResults_joint$mutableNoise == FALSE, ]
numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults_wo_noise$net[allNetsResults_wo_noise$adapted == TRUE]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes_wo_noise <- allNetsResults_wo_noise[allNetsResults_wo_noise$net %in% numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes, ]

# with noise
allNetsResults_w_noise <- allNetsResults_joint[allNetsResults_joint$mutableNoise == TRUE, ]
numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults_w_noise$net[allNetsResults_w_noise$adapted == TRUE]
allNetsWithAdaptedGenes_w_noise <- allNetsResults_w_noise[allNetsResults_w_noise$net %in% numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes, ]

# comparison
length(unique(allNetsResults_wo_noise$net)); length(unique(allNetsResults_w_noise$net))
setdiff(unique(allNetsResults_wo_noise$net), unique(allNetsResults_w_noise$net))

summary(allNetsResults_wo_noise$timeToAdapt_dirSel)
summary(allNetsResults_w_noise$timeToAdapt_dirSel)

plot_timeToAdapt_dirSelPos <- ggplot(allNetsResults_joint, aes(x = mutableNoise, y = timeToAdapt_dirSel)) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.75) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.5, colour = "black") +

        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(x = "Mutable noise", y = "Time to adaptation [# generations]") +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 100000),
                breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
                expand = c(0, 0)) +

plot_timeToAdapt_dirSelPos
ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_timeToAdapt_dirSelPos.png"),
```

## Adaptation (yes/no)

### Adapted - regCategory

```{r preview-adapted-genes-per-regcategory}
contingencyTable <- table(genesUnderDirSel[, c("regCategory", "adapted")])
mosaicplot(contingencyTable, main = "Mosaic plot", color = TRUE)

percF <- contingencyTable[,1]/rowSums(contingencyTable)
percT <- contingencyTable[,2]/rowSums(contingencyTable)
perc <- cbind(rep(names(percF), 2), c(rep("FALSE", 3), rep("TRUE", 3)), c(percF, percT))
colnames(perc) <- c("regCategory", "adapted", "percent")

contingencyTable_melted <- melt(contingencyTable)
contingencyTable_melted <- merge(contingencyTable_melted, perc, by = c("regCategory", "adapted"))
contingencyTable_melted$percent <- as.numeric(as.character(contingencyTable_melted$percent))

# percentage labels
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition <- contingencyTable_melted$value 
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "TRUE"] <-
  contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "TRUE"]/2
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"] <-
  ((contingencyTable_melted$value[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"]/2) + 
  contingencyTable_melted$value[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "TRUE"])
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$regCategory == "TG" & contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"] <- 
  contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$regCategory == "TG" & contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"] + 75

plot_bars_dirSelPos <- ggplot(contingencyTable_melted, aes(x = regCategory, y = value, fill = adapted)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", colour = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = regCategory, y = percentPosition, label = paste0(round(percent*100, digits = 2),"%")), size = 4) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1", name = "Adapted", labels = c("FALSE" = "No", "TRUE" = "Yes")) +
  labs(x = "Regulatory category", y = "Number of genes")
plot_bars_dirSelPos
ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_bars_dirSelPos.png"),
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_dirSelPos_mutNoise,
       plot = plot_bars_dirSelPos, 
       device = "png", scale = 2, width = 6, height = 8, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
```

## Time to adaptation

### Time to adaptation - regCategory

```{r timeToAdapt-regCategory}
stat.test <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(timeToAdapt_dirSel ~ regCategory) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance()
stat.test <- stat.test %>% add_y_position(y.trans = log10)
stat.test$custom.label <- ifelse(stat.test$p.adj <= 0.05, stat.test$p.adj, "ns")
stat.test$y.position <- c(4.001, 4.2, 4.45)

plot_timeToAdapt_dirSelPos <- ggplot(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes, aes(x = regCategory, y = timeToAdapt_dirSel)) + 
  geom_point(color = brewer.pal(n = 3, name = "Pastel1")[2],
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), size = 1, alpha = 0.75) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.5, colour = "black", 
              fill = brewer.pal(n = 3, name = "Pastel1")[2],
              scale = 1, trim = TRUE) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj.signif", bracket.nudge.y = 0.2, tip.length = 0.02) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(x = "Regulatory category", y = "Time to adaptation [# generations]") +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(1, 100000),
                breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
                expand = c(0, 0)) +
```

```{r wilcox-tests-phenotnoise}
dirSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == TRUE, ]
stabSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == FALSE, ]

                                    levels = c("masterTF", "interTF", "TG")),
                       variable = factor(c("Adaptation", "Adaptation", "Postadaptation", "Postadaptation",
                                           "Adaptation", "Adaptation", "Postadaptation", "Postadaptation",
                                           "Adaptation", "Adaptation", "Postadaptation", "Postadaptation"),
                                    levels = c("Adaptation", "Postadaptation")),
```

### Plots

```{r comparisons-of-three-variables}
varChangesDiffPhases <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[, c("aveNormChangeVar_A", "aveNormChangeVar_PA", "regCategory", "underDirSel")]
varChangesDiffPhases <- varChangesDiffPhases[!is.na(varChangesDiffPhases$aveNormChangeVar_A), ]
varChangesDiffPhases_melt <- reshape2::melt(varChangesDiffPhases, id = c("regCategory", "underDirSel"))
levels(varChangesDiffPhases_melt$variable)[levels(varChangesDiffPhases_melt$variable)=='aveNormChangeVar_A'] <-
  'Adaptation'
levels(varChangesDiffPhases_melt$variable)[levels(varChangesDiffPhases_melt$variable)=='aveNormChangeVar_PA'] <-
  'Postadaptation'
varChangesDiffPhases_melt$underDirSel[varChangesDiffPhases_melt$underDirSel == "TRUE"] <- 'Directional'
varChangesDiffPhases_melt$underDirSel[varChangesDiffPhases_melt$underDirSel == "FALSE"] <- 'Stabilizing'
colnames(varChangesDiffPhases_melt)[which(colnames(varChangesDiffPhases_melt) == "underDirSel")] <- "SelectionType"

plot_varChangesDiffPhases <- ggplot(varChangesDiffPhases_melt, 
                                    aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = SelectionType, col = SelectionType)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.6), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) + 
  facet_wrap(~regCategory) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.25, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = wilcoxTests_phenotNoise, aes(x = variable, y = 4, group = SelectionType, label = lab), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), fontface = "bold", size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = wilcoxTests_phenotNoise, aes(x = variable, y = -4, 
                                             group = SelectionType, label = as.character(round(aveNormChangeVar, digits = 2))),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stabilizing" = "darkgray", "Directional" = noiseColor)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Stabilizing" = "darkgray", "Directional" = noiseColor)) + 
  ylim(-4, 4.2) +
  labs(x = "Phase", y = "Rel. change of variance")
plot_varChangesDiffPhases

  labs(x = "Phase", y = "Rel. change of noise genotype")
plot_selPressEtaDiffPhases
```

### genotNoise

```{r linear-models}
dirSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == TRUE, ]
stabSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$underDirSel == FALSE, ]

                   data = dirSelectedGenesInAdaptedNets)

summary(lmModel)$r.squared
plot_constVar_resid <- ggplot(data = data.frame("Fitted_values" = fitted(lmModel),
                               "Pearsons_residuals" = resid(lmModel, type = "pearson")),
                        aes(x = Fitted_values, y = Pearsons_residuals)) +
                        geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.1) + 
                        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
                        theme_bw() +
                        theme(plot.title = element_text(size=8, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
                              axis.title.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
                              axis.title.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
                              axis.text.x = element_text(size=6, face="bold"),
                              axis.text.y = element_text(size=6, face="bold")) +
                        labs(x = "", y = "Pearson's residuals",
                             title = "")# +
                        #annotate("label", x = 0.2, y = -5, label = "Selection", size = 3) +
                        #xlim(0, 1.05) +
                        #ylim(-8, 8)
plot_constVar_resid
plot_constVar_qqResid <- ggplot(data = data.frame("Pearsons_residuals" = resid(lmModel, type = "pearson")),
                                aes(sample = Pearsons_residuals)) +
                        stat_qq(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.2) + stat_qq_line() +
                        theme_bw() +
                        theme(plot.title = element_text(size=8, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
                              axis.title.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
                              axis.title.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
                              axis.text.x = element_text(size=6, face="bold"),
                              axis.text.y = element_text(size=6, face="bold")) +
                        labs(x = "", y = "Sample quantiles",

plot_constVar_qqResid
```
